caption: The drawing is a colored plan of a landscaped area, likely a park or estate, depicted from an overhead view. The area is predominantly green, representing grass and areas covered by trees, with a variety of tree groupings, both scattered and in rows along the boundaries and throughout the property. Pathways and roads, shown in light beige or white, curve naturally throughout the site, forming loops and connecting different sections. Several red-roofed structures of varying shapes and sizes are present: one in the upper left corner, a pair the left-center, a round one in the upper right quadrant, a polygonal or irregularly shaped one in the center-lower right, and one more in the lower left. Open clearings are visible in some areas, as well as a rectangular patterned garden or grid near the center. The outer edges are outlined with regularly spaced trees forming a loose border around most sides except for the corners, where the density is higher. Overall, the predominant colors are shades of green for vegetation, light beige for paths, and red for building roofs, with some gray and brown for additional details.
